transcript: Here is a fact about the iPhone that surprises most people. When the first iPhone went on sale in June 2007, it had no App Store. You could not install a single app from another company. The App Store only arrived in July 2008. About a year later, it opened with just 500 apps. So the phone that changed everything shipped without the thing it is famous for.
